title: LLC federal tax classification
summary: A domestic LLC generally defaults to disregarded status with one owner and partnership status with multiple owners, unless it elects corporate treatment.

title: Instructions for Form 5472
summary: Foreign-owned US disregarded entities with reportable transactions may need Form 5472 attached to a pro forma Form 1120. Owner contributions and distributions can be reportable. Filing failures carry substantial penalties.

title: Instructions for Form SS-4
summary: EIN application routes and responsible-party identification depend on the applicant's circumstances. The online route has location and taxpayer identification requirements; international routes are available.

title: S corporation eligibility
summary: An S corporation cannot have a nonresident alien shareholder. Citizenship alone does not determine tax residency.

title: Determining individual tax residency
summary: Green card and substantial presence tests are relevant to US tax residency, with exceptions and treaty considerations requiring individual analysis.

title: Partnership withholding
summary: Section 1446 withholding can apply to effectively connected taxable income allocated to foreign partners. Foreign ownership alone does not establish effectively connected income.

title: Transfer pricing
summary: Transactions among commonly controlled taxpayers involving services, goods, or intangibles are subject to arm's-length pricing principles.

title: How to form a Delaware business entity
summary: Entity formation includes selecting the entity type, arranging a Delaware registered agent, and submitting the appropriate formation documents.

title: LLC / LP / GP annual tax instructions
summary: The payment guidance states an annual tax due June 1. Its displayed amount differs from the statutory page checked on the same date; this PoC deliberately does not quote a payable amount.

title: Delaware LLC Act, annual tax provisions
summary: The statutory annual-tax amount and the Division's payment guidance are inconsistent in the observed pages. Confirm applicable law, effective date, and assessment with Delaware before payment.

title: Calculating Delaware franchise tax
summary: Corporate franchise tax depends on the calculation method and corporate data. Annual obligations are separate from federal income tax.

title: Current beneficial ownership reporting guidance
summary: Current guidance exempts US-created entities from BOI reporting. The page describes the final rule effective August 14, 2026. Foreign-formed entities registering in the US require separate analysis.

title: Online marketplaces and fulfillment centers
summary: California inventory can create registration obligations. Marketplace facilitator treatment and direct sales must be distinguished; this is not a nationwide state-tax rule.

title: Visitor visas: permitted activities and employment
summary: B-1 visits can include meetings and contract negotiations. Visitor status does not generally authorize employment or work in the US; the proposed activities require immigration review.
